          var st = $(this).scrollTop();

          } else {

          var search_value = '';
          var selected_item = '';

          if (event == null) {
            dataItem = $("#search_v4").data("kendoAutoComplete").value();
          } else {
            dataItem = event.dataItem;
          }

          // The plain title rows, and the trending ones shown before a search: these open on Top Results, since the
          // name alone doesn't say which kind of result was meant.
          if ( typeof(dataItem) == 'string' ) {
            try {
              search_value = $(dataItem).data('search-name');
            } catch(error) {}

            search_value = search_value || dataItem;
            selected_item = kendo.format(decodeURI(seach_redirect_template), '', encodeURIComponent(search_value));
          // This is the returned items from a search
          } else {
            switch(dataItem.media_type) {
              case 'movie':
                selected_item = kendo.format(decodeURI(seach_redirect_template), '/movie', encodeURIComponent(dataItem.name));
                search_value = dataItem.name;
                break;
              case 'tv':
                selected_item = kendo.format(decodeURI(seach_redirect_template), '/tv', encodeURIComponent(dataItem.name));
                search_value = dataItem.name;
                break;
              case 'person':
                selected_item = kendo.format(decodeURI(seach_redirect_template), '/person', encodeURIComponent(dataItem.name));
                search_value = dataItem.name;
                break;
              default:
                selected_item = kendo.format(decodeURI(seach_redirect_template), '', encodeURIComponent(dataItem));

            var fieldLength = value.length;
            autocompleteInput[0].setSelectionRange(fieldLength, fieldLength);

          if (e.metaKey || e.altKey) return;

          var key = e.key;

            if (e.ctrlKey) return;

          if (key === 'b' && $('a.keyboard_s.parent').length) { $('a.keyboard_s.parent')[0].click(); return; }
          if (key === 's' && $('#search_v4').length) {
            e.preventDefault();

  window.tmdbAuthCard = function(card) {

    var panels = {
      login: card.querySelector('[data-auth-panel="login"]'),
      signup: card.querySelector('[data-auth-panel="signup"]'),
      magic_link: card.querySelector('[data-auth-panel="magic_link"]')
    };

    var panelTitles = {
      login: "Login",
      signup: "Sign Up",
      magic_link: "Sign in with Email Link"
    };

    function showPanel(target) {
      var resolvedTarget = panels[target] ? target : "login";

      Object.keys(panels).forEach(function(key) {

          panel.removeAttribute("hidden");
        } else {
          panel.setAttribute("inert", "");
          panel.setAttribute("hidden", "");

      if (firstInput) firstInput.focus();

        onceLink.style.pointerEvents = "none";

      if (switchBtn) showPanel(switchBtn.getAttribute("data-auth-switch"));

      var toggle = e.target.closest("[data-password-toggle]");

        var lastScrollTop = 0;
        var delta = 10;
        var navbarHeight = $('header').outerHeight();

        $(window).scroll(function(event){
          didScroll = true;
        });

        setInterval(function() {
          if (didScroll) {
            hasScrolled();
            didScroll = false;
          }
        }, 250);

        function hasScrolled() {
          var st = $(this).scrollTop();

          if ( Math.abs(lastScrollTop - st) <= delta )
            return;

          if ( st > lastScrollTop && st > navbarHeight ) {
            $('header').removeClass('nav-down').addClass('nav-up');
          } else {
            if ( st + $(window).height() < $(document).height() ) {
              $('header').removeClass('nav-up').addClass('nav-down');
            }
          }

          lastScrollTop = st;

        $("li.translate").on("click", function(e) {
          e.preventDefault();
          var li = $(this);
          var tooltip = li.data("kendoTooltip");

          if (tooltip && tooltip.popup.visible()) {
            tooltip.hide();
            return;
          }

          if (li.find(".translate-loading-spinner").length) return;

          var spinner = $('<span class="translate-loading-spinner"></span>');
          li.append(spinner);

          $.ajax({
            url: translateUrl
          }).done(function(response) {
            spinner.remove();

            if (tooltip) {
              tooltip.destroy();
            }

            li.tmdbTooltip({
              themeClass: "tmdb_theme_white flex",
              autoHide: false,
              content: response,
              showOn: "click",
              width: 300,
              position: "bottom"
            });

            li.data("kendoTooltip").show(li);
          }).fail(function() {
            spinner.remove();
          });

            dataType: "json",
            data: { language: selectedLanguage }
          }).done(function(response) {

            showError();
          });

        var seach_redirect_template = "/search{0}?query=%7B1%7D";
        var processing_selected_item = false;

        function processSelectedItem(event) {
          var dataItem = null;
          var media_type = null;
          var search_value = '';
          var selected_item = '';

          if (event == null) {
            dataItem = $("#search_v4").data("kendoAutoComplete").value();
          } else {
            dataItem = event.dataItem;
          }

          // The plain title rows, and the trending ones shown before a search: these open on Top Results, since the
          // name alone doesn't say which kind of result was meant.
          if ( typeof(dataItem) == 'string' ) {
            try {
              search_value = $(dataItem).data('search-name');
            } catch(error) {}

            search_value = search_value || dataItem;
            selected_item = kendo.format(decodeURI(seach_redirect_template), '', encodeURIComponent(search_value));
          // This is the returned items from a search
          } else {
            switch(dataItem.media_type) {
              case 'movie':
                selected_item = kendo.format(decodeURI(seach_redirect_template), '/movie', encodeURIComponent(dataItem.name));
                search_value = dataItem.name;
                break;
              case 'tv':
                selected_item = kendo.format(decodeURI(seach_redirect_template), '/tv', encodeURIComponent(dataItem.name));
                search_value = dataItem.name;
                break;
              case 'person':
                selected_item = kendo.format(decodeURI(seach_redirect_template), '/person', encodeURIComponent(dataItem.name));
                search_value = dataItem.name;
                break;
              default:
                selected_item = kendo.format(decodeURI(seach_redirect_template), '', encodeURIComponent(dataItem));
                search_value = dataItem;
            }
          }

          $("#search_v4").data("kendoAutoComplete").value(search_value);
          window.location = selected_item;

          dataSource: {
            serverFiltering: true,
            transport: {
              read: '/search/trending',
              parameterMap: function() {
                return { query: $("#search_v4").data("kendoAutoComplete").value() };
              }
            },
            schema: {
              data: "results"
            }
          },
          popup: {
            appendTo: $("section.search")
          },
          filtering: function(e) {

          }

              return;

              processSelectedItem(null);
            }
          }
        });

        });

          var value = autocompleteInput.val();
          if (value == null || value == '') {
            $("#search_v4").data("kendoAutoComplete").search('');
          } else {
            var fieldLength = value.length;
            autocompleteInput[0].setSelectionRange(fieldLength, fieldLength);
          }
        });

        $('header.show_search_false li.search_buttons a.search').on('click', function(e) {
          e.preventDefault();
          showSearch(true);
        });

        $('header.show_search_true li.search_buttons a.search').on('click', function(e) {

        });

        $('header.show_search_false li.search_buttons a.close').on('click', function(e) {
          e.preventDefault();

        });

        $('main.show_search_false').on('click', function(e) {

        });


        public_media_type_map = {

        };

        document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
          if (e.target.closest('[contenteditable], input, textarea, select')) return;
          if (e.metaKey || e.altKey) return;

          var key = e.key;

            if (e.ctrlKey) return;

          if (key === 'b' && $('a.keyboard_s.parent').length) { $('a.keyboard_s.parent')[0].click(); return; }
          if (key === 's' && $('#search_v4').length) {
            e.preventDefault();
            if ($('header').hasClass('show_search_false')) { showSearch(true); } else { $('#search_v4').data('kendoAutoComplete').focus(); $('#search_v4').select(); }
            return;
          }
          if (key === '?') { keyboard_shortcut_popup.open(); return; }
          if (key === 'ArrowLeft' && !window.TMDbImageGallery?.overlay && $('span.previous a.keyboard_s').length) { $('span.previous a.keyboard_s')[0].click(); return; }
          if (key === 'ArrowRight' && !window.TMDbImageGallery?.overlay && $('span.next a.keyboard_s').length) { $('span.next a.keyboard_s')[0].click(); return; }
          if (key === 'm' && $('#new_shortcut_bar').length) { $('#new_shortcut_bar').focus(); return; }
        });
      }).catch(function(error) {
        console.error("Error initializing footer Kendo UI", error);

  window.tmdbAuthCard = function(card) {
    if (!card || card._tmdbAuthCardInit) return;
    card._tmdbAuthCardInit = true;

    var title = card.querySelector("[data-auth-title]");
    var panels = {
      login: card.querySelector('[data-auth-panel="login"]'),
      signup: card.querySelector('[data-auth-panel="signup"]'),
      magic_link: card.querySelector('[data-auth-panel="magic_link"]')
    };

    var panelTitles = {
      login: "Login",
      signup: "Sign Up",
      magic_link: "Sign in with Email Link"
    };

    function showPanel(target) {
      var resolvedTarget = panels[target] ? target : "login";

      Object.keys(panels).forEach(function(key) {
        var panel = panels[key];
        if (!panel) return;

        if (key === resolvedTarget) {
          panel.removeAttribute("inert");
          panel.removeAttribute("hidden");
        } else {
          panel.setAttribute("inert", "");
          panel.setAttribute("hidden", "");
        }
      });

      if (title) {
        title.textContent = panelTitles[resolvedTarget] || panelTitles.login;
      }
      card.setAttribute("data-auth-mode", resolvedTarget);

      card.querySelectorAll("[data-auth-login-only]").forEach(function(el) {
        el.style.display = (resolvedTarget === "login") ? "" : "none";
      });

      var panel = panels[resolvedTarget];
      if (!panel) return;

      var firstInput = panel.querySelector("input:not([type=hidden])");
      if (firstInput) firstInput.focus();
    }

    card.addEventListener("click", function(e) {
      var onceLink = e.target.closest("[data-auth-once]");
      if (onceLink) {
        if (onceLink.dataset.authClicked) {
          e.preventDefault();
          return;
        }
        onceLink.dataset.authClicked = "true";
        onceLink.style.opacity = "0.5";
        onceLink.style.pointerEvents = "none";
      }

      var switchBtn = e.target.closest("[data-auth-switch]");
      if (switchBtn) showPanel(switchBtn.getAttribute("data-auth-switch"));

      var toggle = e.target.closest("[data-password-toggle]");
      if (!toggle) return;

      var wrap = toggle.closest(".auth-field-wrap");
      if (!wrap) return;

      var input = wrap.querySelector("input");
      var eyeOpen = toggle.querySelector(".auth-eye-open");
      var eyeClosed = toggle.querySelector(".auth-eye-closed");

      if (input.type === "password") {
        input.type = "text";
        eyeOpen.style.display = "none";
        eyeClosed.style.display = "";
        toggle.setAttribute("aria-label", "Hide password");
      } else {
        input.type = "password";
        eyeOpen.style.display = "";
        eyeClosed.style.display = "none";
        toggle.setAttribute("aria-label", "Show password");
      }
    });

    card._showPanel = showPanel;
  };

  (function() {
    var overlay = document.getElementById("auth_modal");
    if (!overlay) return;

    var card = overlay.querySelector(".auth-card");

    function openModal(mode) {
      overlay.setAttribute("data-open", "");
      document.body.style.overflow = "hidden";

      setTimeout(function() {
        var panel = card.querySelector('[data-auth-panel="' + (mode || "login") + '"]');
        var firstInput = panel.querySelector("input:not([type=hidden])");
        if (firstInput) firstInput.focus();
      }, 50);
    }

    function closeModal() {
      overlay.removeAttribute("data-open");
      document.body.style.overflow = "";
    }

    overlay.querySelector("[data-auth-close]").addEventListener("click", closeModal);

    document.addEventListener("keydown", function(e) {
      if (e.key === "Escape" && overlay.hasAttribute("data-open")) closeModal();
    });

    document.addEventListener("click", function(e) {
      var trigger = e.target.closest("[data-auth-modal]");
      if (!trigger) return;

      e.preventDefault();
      openModal(trigger.getAttribute("data-auth-modal") || "login");
    });

    window.tmdbAuthModal = { open: openModal, close: closeModal };
  })();

<script type="text/javascript" charset="utf-8" >
  window.PageReady().then(function(ready) {
    var w = window.innerWidth;
    var h = window.innerHeight;
    var loaded_panels = {};

    attachVideoPlayer(w, h);

    (function() {
      var slides = document.querySelectorAll('.hero_slide');
      var links = document.querySelectorAll('.hero_featured_link');
      if (slides.length <= 1) return;

      var total = slides.length;
      var current = 0;
      var interval = null;

      function showSlide(index) {
        slides[current].classList.remove('active');
        links[current].classList.remove('active');
        current = ((index % total) + total) % total;
        slides[current].classList.add('active');
        links[current].classList.add('active');
      }

      function startRotation() {
        clearInterval(interval);
        interval = setInterval(function() {
          showSlide(current + 1);
        }, 6000);
      }

      var isHiDpi = window.devicePixelRatio >= 2;

      function preloadImage(index) {
        var slide = slides[((index % total) + total) % total];
        if (slide) {
          var style = slide.getAttribute('style') || '';
          // URLs contain parens (e.g. filter(duotone,...)), so match up to the closing quote
          var urls = Array.from(style.matchAll(/url\((['"])(.+?)\1\)/g), function(m) { return m[2]; });
          if (urls.length) {
            var img = new Image();
            img.src = (isHiDpi && urls.length > 1) ? urls[1] : urls[0];
          }
        }
      }

      preloadImage(current + 1);
      preloadImage(current + 2);
      startRotation();

      var prevBtn = document.getElementById('hero_prev');
      var nextBtn = document.getElementById('hero_next');

      if (prevBtn) {
        prevBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
          showSlide(current - 1);
          startRotation();
        });
      }

      if (nextBtn) {
        nextBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
          showSlide(current + 1);
          startRotation();
        });
      }

      var heroSection = document.querySelector('.hero_carousel');
      if (heroSection) {
        heroSection.addEventListener('mouseenter', function() {
          clearInterval(interval);
        });
        heroSection.addEventListener('mouseleave', function() {
          startRotation();
        });
      }

      document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function() {
        if (document.hidden) {
          clearInterval(interval);
        } else {
          startRotation();
        }
      });
    })();

    var panel_url_template = "/remote/panel?panel=%7B0%7D&group=%7B1%7D";

    function queryPanel(panel, group) {
      $.ajax({
        dataType: 'html',
        url: kendo.format(decodeURI(panel_url_template), panel, group),
        method: 'GET',
      }).done(function(response) {
        deactivatePageLoader();
        loaded_panels[panel] = true;

        var jpanel = $('#' + panel + ' div.scroller');
        jpanel.fadeOut(500).promise().done(function() {
          jpanel.html(response).addClass('loaded').fadeIn(500).scrollLeft(0);
          initializeScroller(mobileDevice, '#' + panel);

          if (loggedIn) {
            attachOptionsTooltips(false, '#' + panel);
          }

          if (panel == 'trailer_scroller') {
            var videos = $('#' + panel + ' div.scroller').find('.card.true');
            var bg_image = $(videos[0]).data('bg-image');
            if (bg_image) {
              $('section.inner_content.bg_image.video').css({ 'background-image': 'url(' + bg_image + ')' })
            } else {
              $('section.inner_content.bg_image.video').css({ 'background-image': 'none' })
            }
          }
        });
      }).fail(function() {
        deactivatePageLoader();
      });
    }

    function createInview(panel, group) {
      var el = document.getElementById(panel);
      if (!el) return;
      var observer = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries) {
        if (entries[0].isIntersecting) {
          observer.disconnect();
          if (!loaded_panels[panel]) {
            queryPanel(panel, group);
          }
        }
      });
      observer.observe(el);
    }

    queryPanel('trending_scroller', 'today');
    createInview('trailer_scroller', 'popular');

      createInview('popular_scroller', 'streaming');
      createInview('free_scroller', 'movie');

    function updateGroupSelector(selected) {
      var parent = selected.closest('.selector')
      var parent_pos = parent.position();
      var anchor = selected.closest('.anchor');
      var original_anchor = anchor.clone();
      var anchor_pos = anchor.position();

        anchor.parent().find('div.background').css({ 'left': (anchor_pos.left - parent_pos.left - 1), 'width': anchor.outerWidth() });

      parent.find('.anchor').removeClass('selected');
      anchor.addClass('selected');

      return original_anchor;
    }

    $('body').on('mouseover', 'div.card.video.true', function(e) {
      var bg_image = $(this).data('bg-image');
      $('section.inner_content.video').attr('style', 'background-image: url(' + bg_image + ')');
    });

    $('body').on('click', 'div.anchor a', function(e) {
      e.preventDefault();

      var original_anchor = updateGroupSelector($(this));
      var panel = $(this).data('panel');
      var group = $(this).data('group');

      if (!original_anchor.hasClass('selected')) {
        activatePageLoader();
        queryPanel(panel, group);
      }
    });

    $('body').on('click', 'a.refresh_panel', function(e) {
      e.preventDefault();

      var panel = $(this).data('panel');
      var group = $(this).data('group');

      activatePageLoader();
      queryPanel(panel, group);
    });
  });
</script>

        function processSelectedItem(event) {
          var dataItem = null;
          var media_type = null;
          var search_value = '';
          var selected_item = '';

          if (event == null) {
            dataItem = $("#search_v4").data("kendoAutoComplete").value();
          } else {
            dataItem = event.dataItem;
          }

          // The plain title rows, and the trending ones shown before a search: these open on Top Results, since the
          // name alone doesn't say which kind of result was meant.
          if ( typeof(dataItem) == 'string' ) {
            try {
              search_value = $(dataItem).data('search-name');
            } catch(error) {}

            search_value = search_value || dataItem;
            selected_item = kendo.format(decodeURI(seach_redirect_template), '', encodeURIComponent(search_value));
          // This is the returned items from a search
          } else {
            switch(dataItem.media_type) {
              case 'movie':
                selected_item = kendo.format(decodeURI(seach_redirect_template), '/movie', encodeURIComponent(dataItem.name));
                search_value = dataItem.name;
                break;
              case 'tv':
                selected_item = kendo.format(decodeURI(seach_redirect_template), '/tv', encodeURIComponent(dataItem.name));
                search_value = dataItem.name;
                break;
              case 'person':
                selected_item = kendo.format(decodeURI(seach_redirect_template), '/person', encodeURIComponent(dataItem.name));
                search_value = dataItem.name;
                break;
              default:
                selected_item = kendo.format(decodeURI(seach_redirect_template), '', encodeURIComponent(dataItem));
                search_value = dataItem;
            }
          }

          $("#search_v4").data("kendoAutoComplete").value(search_value);

        document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
          if (e.target.closest('[contenteditable], input, textarea, select')) return;
          if (e.metaKey || e.altKey) return;

          var key = e.key;

            if (e.ctrlKey) return;

          if (key === 'b' && $('a.keyboard_s.parent').length) { $('a.keyboard_s.parent')[0].click(); return; }
          if (key === 's' && $('#search_v4').length) {
            e.preventDefault();
            if ($('header').hasClass('show_search_false')) { showSearch(true); } else { $('#search_v4').data('kendoAutoComplete').focus(); $('#search_v4').select(); }
            return;
          }
          if (key === '?') { keyboard_shortcut_popup.open(); return; }
          if (key === 'ArrowLeft' && !window.TMDbImageGallery?.overlay && $('span.previous a.keyboard_s').length) { $('span.previous a.keyboard_s')[0].click(); return; }
          if (key === 'ArrowRight' && !window.TMDbImageGallery?.overlay && $('span.next a.keyboard_s').length) { $('span.next a.keyboard_s')[0].click(); return; }
          if (key === 'm' && $('#new_shortcut_bar').length) { $('#new_shortcut_bar').focus(); return; }
        });

      var switchBtn = e.target.closest("[data-auth-switch]");
      if (switchBtn) showPanel(switchBtn.getAttribute("data-auth-switch"));

      var toggle = e.target.closest("[data-password-toggle]");
      if (!toggle) return;

      var wrap = toggle.closest(".auth-field-wrap");
      if (!wrap) return;

      var input = wrap.querySelector("input");
      var eyeOpen = toggle.querySelector(".auth-eye-open");
      var eyeClosed = toggle.querySelector(".auth-eye-closed");

      if (input.type === "password") {
        input.type = "text";
        eyeOpen.style.display = "none";
        eyeClosed.style.display = "";
        toggle.setAttribute("aria-label", "Hide password");
      } else {
        input.type = "password";
        eyeOpen.style.display = "";
        eyeClosed.style.display = "none";
        toggle.setAttribute("aria-label", "Show password");
      }
    });

    card._showPanel = showPanel;
  };

  (function() {
    var overlay = document.getElementById("auth_modal");
    if (!overlay) return;

    var card = overlay.querySelector(".auth-card");
    window.tmdbAuthCard(card);

    function openModal(mode) {
      overlay.setAttribute("data-open", "");
      document.body.style.overflow = "hidden";
      card._showPanel(mode || "login");
      setTimeout(function() {
        var panel = card.querySelector('[data-auth-panel="' + (mode || "login") + '"]');
        var firstInput = panel.querySelector("input:not([type=hidden])");
        if (firstInput) firstInput.focus();
      }, 50);
    }

    function closeModal() {
      overlay.removeAttribute("data-open");
      document.body.style.overflow = "";
    }

    overlay.querySelector("[data-auth-close]").addEventListener("click", closeModal);

    document.addEventListener("keydown", function(e) {
      if (e.key === "Escape" && overlay.hasAttribute("data-open")) closeModal();
    });

    document.addEventListener("click", function(e) {
      var trigger = e.target.closest("[data-auth-modal]");
      if (!trigger) return;

      e.preventDefault();
      openModal(trigger.getAttribute("data-auth-modal") || "login");
    });

    window.tmdbAuthModal = { open: openModal, close: closeModal };
  })();
</script>

        });

        setInterval(function() {
          if (didScroll) {
            hasScrolled();
            didScroll = false;
          }
        }, 250);

        function hasScrolled() {
          var st = $(this).scrollTop();

          if ( Math.abs(lastScrollTop - st) <= delta )
            return;

          if ( st > lastScrollTop && st > navbarHeight ) {
            $('header').removeClass('nav-down').addClass('nav-up');
          } else {
            if ( st + $(window).height() < $(document).height() ) {
              $('header').removeClass('nav-up').addClass('nav-down');
            }

        var seach_redirect_template = "/search{0}?query=%7B1%7D";
        var processing_selected_item = false;

        function processSelectedItem(event) {
          var dataItem = null;
          var media_type = null;
          var search_value = '';
          var selected_item = '';

          if (event == null) {
            dataItem = $("#search_v4").data("kendoAutoComplete").value();
          } else {
            dataItem = event.dataItem;
          }

          // The plain title rows, and the trending ones shown before a search: these open on Top Results, since the
          // name alone doesn't say which kind of result was meant.
          if ( typeof(dataItem) == 'string' ) {
            try {
              search_value = $(dataItem).data('search-name');
            } catch(error) {}

            search_value = search_value || dataItem;
            selected_item = kendo.format(decodeURI(seach_redirect_template), '', encodeURIComponent(search_value));
          // This is the returned items from a search
          } else {
            switch(dataItem.media_type) {
              case 'movie':
                selected_item = kendo.format(decodeURI(seach_redirect_template), '/movie', encodeURIComponent(dataItem.name));
                search_value = dataItem.name;
                break;
              case 'tv':
                selected_item = kendo.format(decodeURI(seach_redirect_template), '/tv', encodeURIComponent(dataItem.name));
                search_value = dataItem.name;
                break;
              case 'person':
                selected_item = kendo.format(decodeURI(seach_redirect_template), '/person', encodeURIComponent(dataItem.name));
                search_value = dataItem.name;
                break;
              default:
                selected_item = kendo.format(decodeURI(seach_redirect_template), '', encodeURIComponent(dataItem));
                search_value = dataItem;
            }
          }

          $("#search_v4").data("kendoAutoComplete").value(search_value);
          window.location = selected_item;
        }

  window.tmdbAuthCard = function(card) {

    var panels = {
      login: card.querySelector('[data-auth-panel="login"]'),

      var resolvedTarget = panels[target] ? target : "login";

      Object.keys(panels).forEach(function(key) {

        if (!panel) return;

          panel.removeAttribute("hidden");

          panel.setAttribute("inert", "");
          panel.setAttribute("hidden", "");

      window.PageReady().then(function(ready) {

        window.showSearch = function(state) {
          if (state) {
            $('header').removeClass('nav-up').addClass('nav-down');
            $('li.search_buttons a.close').removeClass('hide');
            $('li.search_buttons a.search').addClass('hide');
            $('div.search_bar').removeClass('hide');

            $('div.search_bar').addClass('hide');
          }
        };

        renderTimeago();

        var didScroll;
        var lastScrollTop = 0;
        var delta = 10;
        var navbarHeight = $('header').outerHeight();

        $(window).scroll(function(event){
          didScroll = true;
        });

        setInterval(function() {
          if (didScroll) {
            hasScrolled();
            didScroll = false;
          }
        }, 250);

        function hasScrolled() {
          var st = $(this).scrollTop();

          if ( Math.abs(lastScrollTop - st) <= delta )
            return;

          if ( st > lastScrollTop && st > navbarHeight ) {
            $('header').removeClass('nav-down').addClass('nav-up');
          } else {
            if ( st + $(window).height() < $(document).height() ) {
              $('header').removeClass('nav-up').addClass('nav-down');
            }
          }

          lastScrollTop = st;
        }

            this.element.removeClass('keyboard');
          }
        }).data("kendoTooltip");

        $('button').on('click', function(e) {
            var redirect_url = $(this).data('redirect-url');
            if (redirect_url === undefined) {
              return
            }

            window.location = redirect_url;

        $('li.user a.no_click').tmdbTooltip({

          width: 180,

          content: function() {
            return $("#settings_tooltip").html();

          show: function(e) {
            hover_tooltip.hide();
            if (this.element.hasClass('keyboard')) {

        var translateUrl = '/translation-popup?media_type=&media_id=&referral=%252Fai.txt';

        $("li.translate").on("click", function(e) {
          e.preventDefault();
          var li = $(this);
          var tooltip = li.data("kendoTooltip");

          if (tooltip && tooltip.popup.visible()) {
            tooltip.hide();
            return;
          }

          if (li.find(".translate-loading-spinner").length) return;

          var spinner = $('<span class="translate-loading-spinner"></span>');
          li.append(spinner);

          $.ajax({
            url: translateUrl
          }).done(function(response) {
            spinner.remove();

            if (tooltip) {
              tooltip.destroy();
            }

            li.tmdbTooltip({
              themeClass: "tmdb_theme_white flex",
              autoHide: false,
              content: response,
              showOn: "click",
              width: 300,
              position: "bottom"
            });

            li.data("kendoTooltip").show(li);
          }).fail(function() {
            spinner.remove();
          });
        });

            tooltip.hide();

              autoHide: false,
              content: $("#new_media_template").html(),
              showOn: "click",
              position: "bottom"
            });
            tooltip = li.data("kendoTooltip");

          tooltip.show(li);

          }

          // The plain title rows, and the trending ones shown before a search: these open on Top Results, since the

          if ( typeof(dataItem) == 'string' ) {
            try {
              search_value = $(dataItem).data('search-name');
            } catch(error) {}

            search_value = search_value || dataItem;
            selected_item = kendo.format(decodeURI(seach_redirect_template), '', encodeURIComponent(search_value));
          // This is the returned items from a search
          } else {
            switch(dataItem.media_type) {
              case 'movie':
                selected_item = kendo.format(decodeURI(seach_redirect_template), '/movie', encodeURIComponent(dataItem.name));

          var key = e.key;

            if (e.ctrlKey) return;

          if (key === 'b' && $('a.keyboard_s.parent').length) { $('a.keyboard_s.parent')[0].click(); return; }
          if (key === 's' && $('#search_v4').length) {
            e.preventDefault();

          if (key === 'ArrowRight' && !window.TMDbImageGallery?.overlay && $('span.next a.keyboard_s').length) { $('span.next a.keyboard_s')[0].click(); return; }
